name: montycap
description: Monte Carlo simulation tool for capacity planning

scripts.validate: npx eslint src/simulation.js src/ui.js && npm run build && npx html-validate web/index.html && npm test
scripts.pytm:setup: python3 -m venv pytm-env && pytm-env/bin/pip install -r pytm/requirements.txt
scripts.pytm:dfd: mkdir -p docs/pytm && pytm-env/bin/python3 pytm/montycap.py --dfd | dot -Tpng -o docs/pytm/dfd.png
scripts.pytm: npm run pytm:report && npm run pytm:dfd
